manifest.summary: Manage ZenlessZoneZeroOneDragon script instances, configuration paths, logs, and bound user settings.

diagnostics.zzz_application_start: Confirmed the current application started in its group
diagnostics.zzz_charge_child_error: The current stamina mission raised an exception or failed
diagnostics.zzz_charge_abandoned: Upstream skipped a failed stamina plan; other successes do not recover it
diagnostics.zzz_application_already_done: Application reports it was already completed
diagnostics.zzz_finish_action: The action after ZenlessZoneZero OneDragon finishes may affect subsequent queue work.
diagnostics.zzzonedragon_recursive_group_application: The application group contains a recursive One Dragon entry. Adjust the group configuration first.
diagnostics.zzzonedragon_single_current_instance_req: Select the single-instance mode that runs only the current account.
diagnostics.zzzonedragon_finish_action_requires_host: Set the One Dragon completion action to None or Close Game and let the queue handle completion actions.
diagnostics.zzzonedragon_unknown_enabled_application: The application group contains an enabled application that has not been verified. Check it before running; its settings are preserved.
diagnostics.zzzonedragon_bound_game_path_required: Set the game path in the current account configuration.
diagnostics.zzzonedragon_legacy_group_read_only: The application group uses a legacy format. Its configuration is preserved; migrate and save it in the native application.
diagnostics.zzzonedragon_single_instance_global_requ: Include the global run settings to verify the single-account run scope.
